abstract: Maintains vessel traffic separation approvals and base evacuation transit capacities
system_message:
You are Harbor Traffic Coordinator (HTC). The Harbor Traffic Coordinator (HTC) oversees coastal maritime movement schemes, tracking formal vessel traffic separation approvals and evaluating base vessel evacuation capacities along designated coastal corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel traffic separation approvals and base evacuation transit capacities（TRAF）
information_points.content:
HTC-TRAF-2NO：For Point Carmelo Inshore Channel within the Ningbo maritime administrative region, vessel traffic separation authorization is confirmed, and the channel maintains a base transit capacity of 30 vessels per 24-hour cycle under standard pilotage.
HTC-TRAF-TK0：For North Head Outer Passage within the Ningbo maritime administrative region, vessel traffic separation authorization is confirmed, and the base transit capacity is 24 vessels per 24-hour cycle under standard pilotage.
HTC-TRAF-1FX：For Shoalwater Deep Sound Route within the Ningbo maritime administrative region, vessel traffic separation authorization is not granted, while the base transit capacity is evaluated at 24 vessels per 24-hour cycle under standard pilotage.
HTC-TRAF-WST：For North Head Outer Passage within the Qingdao maritime administrative region, vessel traffic separation authorization is not granted, and the base transit capacity is rated at 18 vessels per 24-hour cycle under standard pilotage.

information_points.title: Quayside mooring assessment（BERTH）
information_points.content:
HTC-BERTH-51O：At the designated emergency disembarkation pier for North Head Outer Passage, the quayside mooring assessment records a heavy mooring bollard count of 16 certified bollards.
HTC-BERTH-415：At the designated emergency disembarkation pier for Shoalwater Deep Sound Route, the quayside mooring assessment records a heavy mooring bollard count of 12 certified bollards.
HTC-BERTH-DTJ：At the designated emergency disembarkation pier for Point Carmelo Inshore Channel, the quayside mooring assessment records a heavy mooring bollard count of 20 certified bollards.
